'''Darok-Tho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]], who was a practitioner of the [[Keetael]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] tradition. [[Acaadi]] once traveled to his homeworld, to study traditions. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], he came to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]], because his master's vision led him to believe that he could aid in defeating Acaadi, as it was believed that he was using the knowledge gained from the Keetael tradition to corrupt others. He agreed to help a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] in defeating him.
